title: Let care reach you, too
script:
For a moment, let the things you are carrying rest beside you. Notice your feet on the floor, or look at one familiar object nearby. Let your breathing stay natural. There is no special way you need to do this.

You have spent so much attention on someone you care about. Listening. Staying up late. Making room for their feelings. Those moments matter. And the tiredness you are feeling matters, too. Both can have a place here.

Wanting a break does not erase your care. Tonight does not have to become another test of how much you love. You do not need to reach exhaustion before your own needs deserve attention.

If you would like, ask yourself a small question: what would feel supportive right now? A quiet meal. An earlier night. Someone listening to you. You do not have to find the perfect answer.

You can care about your partner and still have limits. You can choose how much you have to give tonight. Asking for rest is one way to let your own life take up space.

Slowly notice the room around you again. There is nothing you need to prove in this moment. Perhaps leave a little time for yourself today. The care you offer can include you, too.
